evals.name: implement
evals.prompt: Build a spatial workspace with selectable canvas pins. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Give Canvas the camera and place selectable objects in world coordinates. Anchor screen controls outside that transform.
assertions: Give the world item a stable id and a hit shape in local coordinates. Done: the item at (64,48) responds at that initial location.
Place the camera action relative to the viewport. Use the supplied handle to center and zoom in one operation. Done: the same world point moves to the viewport center.
Give Canvas the camera and place selectable objects in world coordinates. Anchor screen controls outside that transform.

evals.name: diagnose
evals.prompt: Objects draw correctly but selection misses after a pan. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: When drawing and selecting disagree, inspect whether the host applied pan or zoom twice. renderItem creates a local display object; Canvas places it at the item coordinates.
assertions: When drawing and selecting disagree, inspect whether the host applied pan or zoom twice. renderItem creates a local display object; Canvas places it at the item coordinates.
Place the camera action relative to the viewport. Use the supplied handle to center and zoom in one operation. Done: the same world point moves to the viewport center.
Hit-test before and after the move against the actual renderer. Done: the new center selects Pin, its old location misses, and the overlay rectangle does not move.
